mapper.sql: p.id AS id, p.user_id AS userId, p.pet_id AS petId, u.nickname AS authorName, CASE WHEN pt.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pt.name || ' (' || COALESCE(pt.breed, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(pt.age, '') || ')' END AS petInfo, p.title AS title, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS attachedReport, p.content AS content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS commentsCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS likesCount, p.created_at AS createdAt
FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN pets pt ON pt.id = p.pet_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, pet_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{petId}, #{title}, #{content})
